name: Bristol Myers Squibb
outlook:
What Bristol Myers Squibb says to expect

  • Full year 2026: non-GAAP revenueBristol Myers Squibb is increasing its full-year, non-GAAP revenue guidance from a range of approximately $49.0 billion to $50.0 billion to a range of approximately $49.75 billion to $50.25 billion.
  • Full year 2026: other income and expenseFull-year other income/(expense) is now expected to be ~$650 million of expense, due to favorable net interest.
  • Full year 2026: non-GAAP earnings per shareNon-GAAP EPS is being updated to an anticipated range of $6.35 - $6.55, which is inclusive of a $(0.60) impact from Acquired IPRD and licensing income.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
